Reliance Jio IPO Buzz Boosts RIL Share Price

Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) shares saw a rise amid speculation surrounding a potential Initial Public Offering (IPO) for its digital arm, Jio Platforms. Experts suggest a demerger of Jio Platforms from RIL could clarify the conglomerate's stake in its digital and telecom businesses. The Grey Market Premium (GMP) for the anticipated Jio IPO was reported at 18%, with first-time investors advised to monitor three key factors. Akash Ambani outlined five major growth plans for Jio, including 5G rollout by 2030 and expanding Artificial Intelligence (AI) services globally.
